verdict.rationale: LiveKit is an API-driven platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only static code examples, such as the token-grant example, and a browser-based Agent Builder. Neither is an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
